title: Trail cutting diagonally through cloud bank (Fig. 6)
description: Photograph, mounted sideways, showing a thin diagonal trail crossing a bank of cloud beneath a dark sky, with a strip of another image showing water at the right edge. Labelled "Fig. 6" in the margin with an "A.C." photo number at lower right. Accompanies the Harmon Field, Newfoundland trail sighting of July 1947.
